# Weekend Reads

**Top story:** The Halden Rail strike is over after 9 days. Workers accepted a deal with a 7% raise over two years and new limits on overnight shifts. Full service resumes Monday. https://weekendreads.example/halden

**Also worth your time:**
1. [Why the Ostrava ferry still runs on a 1950s timetable](https://weekendreads.example/ferry)
2. [Inside a seed bank in the Varnholt hills](https://weekendreads.example/seeds)
3. [The best $15 kitchen knife, tested](https://weekendreads.example/knife)

Forward this to a friend: https://weekendreads.example/share
